text:
Aisha: Morning team — kicking off onboarding for Fennec. Main goals: basic integration, 2-week pilot, and 20% active user adoption in 30 days.
Luca: Quick Q — do we have IAM/KMS access details from Fennec or should we set up a staging key?
Marta (Fennec): I can share orgID and the SAML contact — sending via secure email after this thread. Security lead (Anil) will join first sync.
Ben: I'll own infra setup and the Dedicated capacity request. I'll need the orgID + expected RPS to size GPU pool.
Luca: I'll own embeddings and prompt benchmark tests. Planning to run an initial pass Wed morning.
Aisha: Proposed success criteria (agreed with product): 1) p50 latency <200ms for 512-token baseline, 2) sample prompts hit expected accuracy on our eval set, 3) 20% DAU adoption from pilot cohort within 30 days, 4) zero P0 exceptions for 7 consecutive days post-launch.
Marta (Fennec): Those look good. For adoption, we'll provide a 500-user pilot cohort.
Ben: High-level timeline: Week 0 (now) — access + infra, Week 1 — prompt tuning + evals, Week 2 — pilot start + monitoring, Week 4 — review & renewal check-in.
Aisha: Risk buckets (short): Access delays, Prompt quality regressions, Cost spikes, Compliance review holdups. Assigning owners: Access = Marta/IT, Prompts = Luca, Cost = Sophie.
Sophie: I'll set budget alerts and a spend runway report. Recommend a $X/day soft cap for initial burst and auto-notify channel.
Luca: Enablement plan: 60-min dev walkthrough (recorded), 30-min PM product ops, + sample prompts and runbook. Proposed time for walkthrough: Tue 11:00 PT.
Marta (Fennec): Tue 11:00 PT works. We'll invite our PM and security lead.
Luca: I'll draft a short runbook and include a curl example for quick smoke tests: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwoodai.com/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"model":"redwood-1","prompt":"Summarize the user message"}'```
Ben: I'll open the Dedicated capacity ticket today (ticket #TBD) — expect ETA ~72h after approval.
Aisha: Monitoring plan: per-route dashboards, token-level cost breakdown, latency SLOs. Sophie please add a daily digest to the pilot channel.
Sophie: Done — I'll add cost & latency digest at 08:00 PT daily and an alert if projected spend > 85% of budget.
Aisha: Feedback capture: shared Notion page + weekly 30-min syncs (Mon). Please add any prompt regressions or edge cases to the Notion issue table.
Marta (Fennec): We'll add first set of integration questions to Notion and invite our UX lead for qualitative feedback.
Aisha: Next steps (owners): Ben — raise Dedicated ticket and confirm ETA; Luca — run embeddings + sample prompts Wed; Sophie — configure budget alert; Marta — share SAML/orgID and confirm pilot cohort list.
Ben: Ack, raising ticket now.
Luca: Ack, will post results in this thread after Wed run.
Sophie: Ack, I'll confirm alert configs by EOD.
Marta (Fennec): Sending SAML contact and orgID to Aisha and Ben now.
Aisha: Thanks everyone — recording action items and will create the Notion kickoff doc. First weekly sync Monday 09:30 PT. :thumbsup:
